def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    coupon_payments = [5000, 5000, 5000]
    principal = 100000
    treasury_yield = 0.025
    spread = 0.012
    discount_rate = treasury_yield + spread

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    call_price = sum(
        payment / ((1 + discount_rate) ** (year + 1))
        for year, payment in enumerate(coupon_payments)
    )
    call_price += principal / ((1 + discount_rate) ** len(coupon_payments))
    answer = round(call_price)

    # return answer
    return answer
